error.invalid_key: The advertisement key must be 32 hexadecimal characters (16 bytes).
error.key_mismatch: This key does not match the advertisements the device is currently broadcasting.

data_description.key: The 32-character hex Instant Readout key from VictronConnect.
VictronConnect issues a new key each time Instant Readout is re-paired.

data_description.throttle_seconds: Numeric updates have a 60-second minimum. Energy counters and time estimates have a five-minute minimum. Advertisements are still parsed at full rate and alarm changes are immediate.
